description: TC-03 failed: main contactor opened 260 ms after E-stop actuation (SYS-05 / ELEC-01 require <= 200 ms). Cause: coil flyback diode extends drop-out. Proposed fix: replace diode with TVS/RC snubber or route E-stop to the controller's inhibit input in parallel.
TC-09: packet loss 6 % beyond 1.6 km with shore antenna at 1.5 m; suspect Fresnel clearance. Action: mast-mount the shore antenna at 4 m and retest; fallback is a 6 dBi shore yagi.
